title: merge and find_lcp keep their lengths and LCPs as usize and cast at the array boundary
body:
In `merge` and `find_lcp` in `libsufr/src/build/sort.rs`, locals that are lengths or LCPs are typed `W`: `m`, `l_x`, `context`, `max_n`, and the value `find_lcp` returns. Every comparison against `text.len()`, `max_query_len` or a mask position casts with `to_usize`, and `find_lcp` casts with `from_usize` on each of its four returns. 15 `from_usize` calls in the crate, 9 of them here.

## Proposal

Those locals are `usize`. The cast happens once where a value is loaded from a `W` array and once where one is stored, so `from_usize` is left at the stores: `partition`'s push, two subsample pushes, the LCP stores in `merge`, `first_lcps`. `find_lcp` returns `usize` and is no longer generic. The three `vec![W::from_usize(0); n]` in `typed.rs` become `W::default()`.

## Rejected

A newtype over the text indexed by `W`, `sufr-d92278`: with the text as `MemorySource<u8>` the one line that gains is the byte compare in `merge`, against a `Deref`, two `Index` impls and seven signatures.

## Cost

`merge` and `find_lcp` are the hot loops. Before and after on the board, 4 threads, 5 repeats; I expect no change, since the casts are free and the comparisons already widen.
